title: Walter H. Gale Professor of Education and Economics
bio: Professor Thomas Kane's work has spanned both K-12 and higher education, covering topics such as the design of school accountability systems, teacher recruitment and retention, financial aid for college, race-conscious college admissions and the earnings impacts of community colleges.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
